title: open access feminism
subtitle: Removing the barriers to accessing feminist literature, academia, and radical theory
why: got me started reading feminist lit, they have almost any author you could want!
description: We aim to provide a growing list of PDFs and links to feminist books and academic literature in the aim of promoting open access.  We hope this website will serve as starting point for those interested in learning more about radical thought and the history of women's liberation, including its most enlightened and revolutionary thinkers.
